# Linktree
> Linktree is a link-in-bio platform that helps creators, brands, and businesses share, sell, and manage everything from one simple link.

Linktree combines a customizable bio link page with tools for link shortening, QR codes, social media management, commerce, and audience engagement. It is used by creators and businesses to centralize online presence and direct audiences to content, products, and channels.

## Core Product
- [Link in Bio](https://linktr.ee/link-in-bio): Customize a Linktree page to share links, content, and offers from one bio link.
- [Link Shortener](https://linktr.ee/features/link-shortener): Create trackable, shareable short links for campaigns, social posts, and promotions.
- [QR Code Generator](https://linktr.ee/features/qr-code-generator): Turn links into scannable QR codes for print, events, packaging, and offline promotion.
- [Manage Your Social Media](https://linktr.ee/solutions/manage-your-social-media): Organize social media destinations and drive followers to key content and channels.

## Features
- [Link Shortener](https://linktr.ee/features/link-shortener): Generate branded, measurable short links for easier sharing and analytics.
- [QR Code Generator](https://linktr.ee/features/qr-code-generator): Create QR codes that connect audiences directly to links and landing pages.
- [Link in Bio](https://linktr.ee/link-in-bio): Build a mobile-friendly landing page for all your important links.
- [Manage Your Social Media](https://linktr.ee/solutions/manage-your-social-media): Simplify social media link management across platforms and campaigns.

## Solutions
- [Manage Your Social Media](https://linktr.ee/solutions/manage-your-social-media): Centralize social destinations and improve traffic flow from social profiles.

- [Manage Your Social Media](https://linktr.ee/solutions/manage-your-social-media): Coordinate audience journeys across multiple social platforms.

## Business Use Cases

- [Link Shortener](https://linktr.ee/features/link-shortener): Support marketing campaigns with compact links and performance tracking.
